message.content: {"note_claim": "Blue Origin's New Glenn exploded in May 2026, suspending operations, so no New Glenn launches or booster landings have occurred since.", "label": "PARTIAL", "quote": "Blue Origin continues to analyze the explosion of its New Glenn rocket a little more than a month ago, but on Tuesday, CEO Dave Limp shared the company’s plan for resuming pad operations later this year.", "reason": "The page confirms the New Glenn explosion and a launch pause, but it says return to flight is planned by end of 2026, contradicting the 'late 2029' claim, and doesn't address April 2026 landings."}

parsed.note_claim: Blue Origin's New Glenn exploded in May 2026, suspending operations, so no New Glenn launches or booster landings have occurred since.
parsed.label: PARTIAL
parsed.quote: Blue Origin continues to analyze the explosion of its New Glenn rocket a little more than a month ago, but on Tuesday, CEO Dave Limp shared the company’s plan for resuming pad operations later this year.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the New Glenn explosion and a launch pause, but it says return to flight is planned by end of 2026, contradicting the 'late 2029' claim, and doesn't address April 2026 landings.
